inputs.original_text: This wasn’t just a memo being misread. ICE lawyers relied on a document that gave no authority to arrest people leaving immigration court, yet thousands were arrested. The lawsuit is peeling back the cover story: the system appears designed to turn people seeking legal status into targets, while institutions invoke the law to disguise how they’re getting around it. The “paperwork mistake” explanation is exactly the kind of excuse that keeps the machinery protected.
inputs.modified_text: This was never just a paperwork mix-up. ICE lawyers relied on a document that gave them no authority to arrest people leaving immigration court, and thousands were arrested anyway. The “mistake” story protects the machinery: people seeking legal status are being turned into targets, while institutions hide behind legal language to make the workaround look legitimate. The lawsuit is beginning to expose how deliberate that arrangement appears to be.
